GeneThrive Protocol Engine

Practitioner Use Only. This tool presents candidate items and their evidence grading based on confirmed genetic variants and clinical data — it supports the authorising practitioner's judgement, it does not replace it and does not auto-prescribe. Nothing is compiled into the Compounding Script unless the practitioner explicitly accepts it (see the Item pre-selection mode banner above). Rule 0.25 evidence audit must be completed before issue. AI knowledge cutoff: August 2025.
